main_text.l: כָּנָף c. Ala, Ora: duale, כְּנָפַיִם & femin. נִכְנַף, כַּנְפּוֹרֶת Niphal Alis uti vel aufugere.
כִּנּוֹר כנר m. Cithara: plur. כִּנּוֹרוֹת כִּנּוֹרִים.
כִּנֵּשׁ Chald. Congregare. Hithpahel, הִתְכַּנֵּשׁ Congregari.
כִּסֵּא כְּסֵה כִּסֵּא m. Solium, Thronus: plur. כִּסְאוֹת.
כִּסָּה Tegere, Operire, Occultare, Celare. Pihel כִּסָּה idem. Niphal נִכְסֶה Pyhal כֻּסָּה Operiri. Hithpahel הִתְכַּסֶּה Tegere, Operire se, Operiri.
מִכְסֶה מִכְסֶה כִּסּוּי m. כִּסּוּת f. Tegmen, Tegumentum, Operimentum; Operculum.
כְּסִיל m. Stultus, Stolidus: item, Orion, Sydus caeleste: plur. כְּסִילִים.
כֶּסֶל m. כִּסְלוּת כִּסְלָה f. Stultitia, Stoliditas, Fatuitas.
כִּסָּמֶת f. Spelta, zea: plur. כִּסָּמִים.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation is partly uncertain in this scan, especially the points on the headwords and the Niphal and Pyhal forms; the Hebrew letters are copied as far as they can be read. The first headword and the Hebrew of several entries are blurred by stains.
